cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
for name in ('tmp/t_plan.py','tmp/t_plan2.py'):
    src=open(name).read()
    src=src.replace("""    return {'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':leases,'services':services,'queries':[10,20],
            'captures':[],'requests':requests,'offers':offers,""",
"""    import base64
    HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,'
            'result,service,attempt,payload')
    rows=[f'icmp,d{i},0,9,put,L1,1,0/i{1+int(r["target"][-1])},{r["target"]},{r["target"]},echo,,,'
          for i,r in enumerate(requests)]
    data='\\r\\n'.join([HEADER]+rows)+'\\r\\n'
    captures=[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()]}] if rows else []
    return {'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':leases,'services':services,'queries':[10,20],
            'captures':captures,'requests':requests,'offers':offers,""")
    open(name,'w').write(src)
PYEOF
